items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: Was there any of the songs that you wrote, like in the 50s, for Harold or Rick, that was some kind of dance concept?

ctx.x: Harold, that's Harold. He's, but everybody else, we're good, good, pretty good. We came from a pretty good family, you know, poor but good.
You're talking about getting the switch from the father. What, what, what, what, what would you have to do?
